Reviews.sectionTitle: Many couples have trusted me. Here's what they say.

reviews.1: Our wedding was absolutely magical and the dance floor never emptied! The DJ read the crowd perfectly, keeping everyone dancing from grandma to the youngest guests.
reviews.2: Professionalism at the highest level. Communication was effortless and every song request was honored. The sound and lighting were seriously impressive. Worth it!
reviews.3: We threw a 40th birthday and needed someone to get the crowd going. Perfect match! Great energy, real connection with guests, and music for every taste.
reviews.4: Really good to work with, though a bit more classic music for the older guests would have helped. Still, the atmosphere was great and the floor stayed packed.
reviews.5: The best decision in planning our wedding! Seamless transitions, great timing, and tons of energy. Our guests still talk about it. Thank you!
reviews.6: We booked for a company party and it was a bullseye. Professional, punctual, and music tuned to a very mixed crowd. We'll definitely book again.
reviews.7: Great fun and an amazing vibe! The only thing I'd note was the volume early on — but one word and it was fixed right away.
reviews.8: Brilliant from start to finish. He ran our wedding with great instinct, the games were fun, and the music kept the floor ready all night!
reviews.9: Lovely to work with and a truly personal approach to what we wanted. The playlist was spot on and the dance floor stayed hot until the very end.
reviews.10: Professional approach and great communication. The party was a success, though we wanted a longer closing set — we sorted it on site. Very positive overall!

FAQ.sectionTitle: Before you write maybe this helps

availability.question: Is my date still available?
availability.answer: The best way to find out is to reach out with your date and venue. I keep my calendar up to date and will confirm availability right away — popular dates, especially in summer, tend to book up months in advance, so it's worth asking early.

travel.question: Do you travel across Poland?
travel.answer: Yes, I play events all over Poland. Travel within the local area is included, and for venues further away I simply add a transparent travel fee that we agree on upfront — no surprises.

songs.question: Can we choose the songs ourselves?
songs.answer: Absolutely. Before the event we go through your must-play list, any songs to avoid, and the moments that matter most to you. From there I read the room and blend your requests with tracks that keep the dance floor full all night.

ceremony.question: What about ceremony music?
ceremony.answer: I can handle music for the whole day, including the ceremony. We'll plan the entrance, key moments, and background sound together so every part flows smoothly and sounds exactly how you imagined.

equipment.question: What if the equipment fails?
equipment.answer: I always bring backup gear — spare controllers, cables, and audio sources — so the music never stops. Reliable, professional-grade equipment plus redundancy means technical issues stay invisible to you and your guests.

booking.question: How does booking a date work?
booking.answer: It's simple: send me a message with your date and details, we talk through what you're looking for, and once everything fits I reserve the date with a signed agreement and a deposit. After that, your date is locked in.

2.title: What Data We Collect
2.content: We collect the data you provide voluntarily when filling out the contact or quote form: first and last name, email address, phone number, and information about your planned event.

3.title: Purpose of Data Processing
3.content: We process your data solely to respond to your enquiry, prepare a service quote, and perform the contract. Your data is not shared with third parties or used for marketing purposes without your consent.

5.title: Data Retention Period
5.content: We store data for the period necessary to fulfil the purpose for which it was collected, and after that purpose has been fulfilled, for the time required by law (e.g. by tax regulations).

6.title: Your Rights
6.content: You have the following rights: the right to access your data, the right to rectify your data, the right to erase your data, the right to restrict processing, the right to data portability, and the right to withdraw consent at any time.
